posts.text: Achievement unlocked: I'm going to be the guest of honor at a con that I attended for the first time when I was in high school.
I feel this is a good time to channel @swordsjew.bsky.social's sandwich opinions.
Straps coach put on the soundtrack to the Rocky Horror Picture Show during training today and everyone in the gym knew the words. Circus aerialists are just theater kids with biceps.
It's that time of day where I can't tell if I'm having a lot of feelings about tech critics taking pot shots at other tech critics or if I just need a sandwich.
Really, he should be flattered. They're probably just flirting.
This Cooper guy seems pretty cool.
